Lemma
[Comparable areas of the isoperimetric regions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0111 ↗ prop:chow-iv-isoperimetric-loop-bounds 1. ch29:29.23\group Isoperimetry

There is $c>0$ such that the two regions cut out by any minimizing loop satisfy \[ c|t|\le A_\pm (\gamma _t)\le 8\pi |t|\qquad (t\le -1). \]
